planner_visibility.visible_columns: identifier + required disjoint groups + primary_feature=true descriptor columns

scientific_boundary: Partition assignment must not use energy_above_hull values.
Whole chemical-system groups must remain in exactly one partition.
Reduced-formula groups must not cross partitions.
Acquisition labels are oracle-only until a later costed acquisition action explicitly reveals them.
Locked-test rows and targets must never be exposed to a planner or used for action selection, tuning, stopping-rule design, or model selection.
This partition contract creates no new predictive, causal, synthesizability, or discovery claim.
